name: sc008-summary-record-edges
description: 018, T079 (FR-017, contracts/summary-record.md §3/§6): three settled stories under one parent, differing only in their recorded summary. PRSV-2's record equals its current summary, so the specification's new title lands silently (§4 row 2). PRSV-3's current summary already equals exactly what the specification names, even though the recorded value is stale — the drift check is inert for it (never treated as drift), so the summary is (re)sent carrying that same value and nothing warns. PRSV-4's recorded summary differs from its current one only by whitespace — normalised-equal per §3 — so its retitle also lands silently. No ticket in this run produces a warning — byte-identical across ports.
